note: Cactus is not a polyculture crop -- it's Cactus.md's size/sort cascade: cacti grow to a random fixed size 0-9, and harvesting a fully-grown cactus whose neighbors are also fully-grown and sorted (non-decreasing North/East) cascades recursively, yielding 32*n**2 Items.Cactus for an n-cactus cascade (002, exact formula, confirmed at n=2, n=16, and n=64). 32*8**2=131,072 is exactly the target -- the category is solved by building one fully-sorted 8x8 grid and harvesting a single corner. Sorting uses a classical lemma (sort every row, then every column -- rows stay sorted) validated at 4x4 (003) then full 8x8 (004): real score 00:54.267, Global Rank #350, 131,072/131,072 on every one of 133 internal repeats. Leader scores 00:07.447 (7.3x faster) -- the bubble-sort (~290k of ~330k avg ticks) is the clear next lever, see queue.md. See experiments/cactus_single/00{1,2,3,4}/result.md and queue.md.
